H: A fully source-bound XRes incarnation guard reproduces fail-closed stale-alias refusal on a private Linux/Xvfb server when p1 and p2 demonstrably reuse the same XID, geometry and exact client-window bytes captured separately while each process is alive, but XRes LocalClientPID and contemporaneous /proc start ticks identify different process incarnations.
T: One fresh allocation: observe/mint p1; query XRes identity and capture p1 window bytes while p1 is alive; exit p1; create p2; require same XID, geometry and byte-identical window content using the retained pre-exit p1 bytes versus a distinct post-reuse p2 read; query XRes; attempt stale alias once. Require refusal before bridge.click with zero emissions/effect. Only then run one fresh p2 alias positive control.
D: Retain immutable raw bytes including capture and exit monotonic timestamps, XRes replies, p1 and p2 window byte arrays/hashes, guard decision, bridge-entry/emission counters, independent effect, release, cleanup and image manifest. Separate raw-only auditor must require p1 pixel capture timestamp < p1 exit observation < p2 start, verify pixel bytes/hashes, validate cleanup/releases, and detect corruptions.
C: Private local Xvfb only; no remote-X11 or production/default-runtime claim. XRes PID is corroborative; missing/inconsistent PID or /proc start ticks fail closed. No changes to v1 or runtime defaults. No retries. Positive control is conditional on safe stale refusal.
U: Whether the properly measured, fully source-bound allocation reproduces the scoped guard finding. Any PASS is one local allocation only and not production security, general visual-target reliability, or completion of #3311.

decision_rules.PASS_PROVENANCE_COMPLETE_XRES_GUARD_REPR: Source/freeze/image hashes verify before Xvfb/fixture; all XID/identity/geometry/independently captured pixel gates hold; stale alias is refused as PROCESS_INCARNATION_MISMATCH before bridge.click with zero emissions/effect; conditional fresh control succeeds with exact effect and verified empty release; process cleanup and independent raw/artifact audit pass.
decision_rules.STOP_BEFORE_INPUT: Any freeze/source/image/XRes/identity prerequisite unavailable before stale-alias input; preserve outcome and stop.
decision_rules.FAIL_STALE_ALIAS_ADMITTED: Stale alias reaches bridge/native input or produces any p2 effect; stop without fresh control.
decision_rules.HOLD_AUDIT: Any raw lineage, independent reconstruction, timing, pixel provenance, release, or cleanup evidence incomplete.
